info.name: Clients AR Account reports Suppliers API
List the suppliers of an entity

params.name: erpId
params.description: Optional filter on a single ERP identifier.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of suppliers per page (1 to 1000, default 1000).

items.docs:
Returns the suppliers of an entity using cursor-based pagination, so ERP Connectivity can
diff its catalog against Agicap. Pass the nextCursor of a previous page to fetch the next one.
Use the optional erpId filter to look up a single supplier.

Pushes up to 1000 suppliers (create / update / delete) for an entity in a single call.
Processing is synchronous and returns a syncId usable to fetch the row-by-row errors.
If the same erpId appears more than once in a batch, all of its occurrences are rejected and reported as row errors.

info.name: Get the synchronization errors of a batch

params.name: syncId
params.description: Synchronization identifier returned by the synchronize endpoint.

params.name: after
params.description: Opaque cursor returned as cursor.after by the previous page. Omit to fetch the first page.

items.docs:
Returns the row-by-row errors of a previous synchronization, paginated.
The syncId is the one returned by the synchronize endpoint.
